tools.name: get_coverage
tools.description: Read-only. Lists the trades supported and tells you whether a city in Canada or the United States is covered, and whether we already have a ranked provider shortlist there (pre_ranked) or will source providers when the request arrives (live_sourced). Call this before request_quotes if you are unsure

tools.name: request_quotes
tools.description: Use when a customer wants an agent to find and book a home-service contractor (plumber, HVAC, electrician, roofer, appliance repair, locksmith, garage door, pest control, handyman, house cleaning, or another trade) at an address in Canada or the United States. GTA customers can also start at https:/

tools.name: get_request_status
tools.description: Read-only. Returns the current status of a request created with request_quotes, plus any assigned contractor and quotes on file. Requires the request_id and either the email or the phone number given on the request. It never returns the customer's contact details, address, or internal notes.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: request_quotes, get_request_status · Private data: get_coverage, request_quotes, get_request_status · Public sink: request_quotes, get_request_status.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: request_quotes, get_request_status · Private data: get_coverage, request_quotes, get_request_status · Public sink: request_quotes, get_request_status

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
